facts.text: Casa San Agustin is a boutique hotel made of three houses inspired by Cartagena's colonial heritage.
facts.excerpt: a boutique hotel made of three houses all inspired by Cartagena’s colonial heritage

facts.text: The hotel occupies three whitewashed colonial buildings in Cartagena's historic center.
facts.excerpt: Three whitewashed colonial buildings with 30 guest rooms and suites in Cartagena's historic center.

facts.text: The interiors feature wooden-beamed ceilings and wall frescos.
facts.excerpt: The wooden-beamed ceilings and wall frescos infuse your stay with the charm of our history

facts.text: The hotel's traditional decoration tells the story of its 17th-century beginnings.
facts.excerpt: Simple but sophisticated traditional decoration tells the story of our 17th century beginnings

facts.text: Stays come with outdoor spaces, luxurious linens and hand-picked amenities.
facts.excerpt: the sumptuous comfort of outdoor spaces, luxurious linens, and hand-picked amenities

facts.text: The Aurum Spa's Hammam ritual uses a scrub made of coffee, volcanic mud and pure tobacco after a steam room cleanse.
facts.excerpt: The body is rinsed and cleansed in a moist steam room before a vigorous exfoliation with a scrub made of coffee, volcanic mud and pure tobacco

facts.text: Aurum Spa takes its name from the Latin word for gold.
facts.excerpt: Aurum is the Latin word for “gold” or “brilliant sunrise”.

facts.text: The spa's Time is Gold ritual coats the body in a golden emulsion after a Hammam exfoliation, ending with a facial and body massage.
facts.excerpt: It begins with an exfoliation in the Hammam, followed by coating the body in a shiny, golden emulsion to nourish the skin and ending with a soothing facial and body massage.

facts.text: The spa offers a Cartagena coffee body scrub.
facts.excerpt: CARTAGENA COFFEE BODY SCRUB

facts.text: A couples ritual begins with a soak in the jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: A romantic ritual.  Begin this experience with a soak in the jacuzzi

facts.text: Acasi Beach is the hotel's private beach on the island of Baru.
facts.excerpt: A private beach on the island of Barú, one of the iconic spots on the Caribbean coast, with white sandy beaches and turquoise waters

facts.text: Acasi Beach is one hour from Cartagena.
facts.excerpt: 1 hour from   Cartagena

facts.text: At Acasi Beach, guests can stay in rustic beach bungalows overlooking the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Wake up overlooking the Caribbean Sea in your rustic beach bungalow

facts.text: Alma Restaurant's dishes echo the flavors and colors of Cartagena.
facts.excerpt: each dish in the Alma Restaurant echoing the flavors and colors of Cartagena

facts.text: The hotel also has the Alma Bar.
facts.excerpt: **Alma Bar** Explore

facts.text: Concierges curate experiences in Cartagena.
facts.excerpt: Cartagena curated by our concierges.

facts.text: Aurum Spa opened in April 2016.
facts.excerpt: Aurum Spa opened in April 2016.

facts.text: Casa San Agustin appeared on Conde Nast Traveler's Gold List 2020.
facts.excerpt: Gold List 2020

facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2018, 2022, 2023
